results.name: Barbell Full Squat Wide
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back. Grip the bar with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Begin the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees, lowering your body until your thighs are slightly below than parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position, extending your hips and knees fully. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your chest up and back straight to maintain proper posture and alignment.
Focus on driving through your heels to engage your glutes and quadriceps effectively.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you stand up and inhaling as you lower down.
results.description: Barbell Full Squat Wide is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Lower Back.

results.name: Barbell Full Zercher Squat
instructions: Position a barbell in a squat rack at about waist height. Stand close to the barbell and hook your arms under it, holding the bar in the crook of your elbows with your hands close in front of your chest.
Lift the barbell off the rack by standing up straight. Step back and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly pointed out.
Maintain a neutral spine as you begin the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees, lowering your body until your thighs are parallel to the floor or slightly below.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position, extending your hips and knees until you are fully upright. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Move slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you push up and inhaling as you lower down.
Distribute your weight evenly across your feet to ensure balance and stability.
results.description: Barbell Full Zercher Squat is an advanced multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Lower Back, Forearms.

results.name: Barbell Glute Bridge (Hands on Bar)
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, shoulder-width apart. Place a barbell across your hips, holding it securely with both hands.
Push through your heels to lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement and hold for a brief moment.
Lower your hips back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Drive through your heels to engage your glutes and hamstrings effectively.
Ensure your knees stay in line with your toes and do not flare out or cave inward.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your hips and inhaling as you lower them back down.
Use a pad or towel on the barbell for added comfort on your hips.
results.description: Barbell Glute Bridge (Hands on Bar) is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Lower Back.

results.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back resting against a bench, knees bent, and feet flat on the floor. Roll a barbell over your hips, holding it securely with both hands.
Push through your heels to lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement and hold for a brief moment, ensuring your hips are fully extended.
Lower your hips back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Drive through your heels to engage your glutes and hamstrings effectively.
Ensure your knees stay in line with your toes and do not flare out or cave inward.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your hips and inhaling as you lower them back down.
Use a pad or towel on the barbell for added comfort on your hips.
results.description: Barbell Hip Thrust is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Lower Back.

results.name: Barbell Jefferson Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, positioning yourself so that the barbell is between your legs. Grip the barbell with one hand in front of you and one hand behind you, using an overhand grip for the front hand and an underhand grip for the back hand.
Begin the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees, lowering your body until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position, extending your hips and knees fully. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on even weight distribution between both legs to ensure balanced muscle activation.
Use your glutes and hamstrings to power the upward phase of the squat.
Keep your grip firm but relaxed to prevent unnecessary tension in your arms and shoulders.
results.description: Barbell Jefferson Squat is an advanced multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Lower Back.

results.name: Barbell Jump Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back. Grip the bar with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Begin the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees, lowering your body until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Explosively push through your heels to jump straight up, extending your hips and knees fully to jump.
Land softly on your forefeet, immediately bending your knees and hips to absorb the impact and lower back into the squat position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure the barbell remains steady on your back to prevent it from shifting during the exercise.
Keep your knees aligned with your toes to avoid knee injuries.
Start with a lighter weight to master the form and technique before progressing to heavier loads.
results.description: Barbell Jump Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the plyometric category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Barbell Kas Glute Bridge

Push through your heels to lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees. Your upper back should remain on the bench.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement and hold for a brief moment, ensuring your hips are fully extended.
Lower your hips a few inches with control and repeat the movement for the desired repetitions.
tips: Drive through your heels to engage your glutes and hamstrings effectively.
Ensure your knees stay in line with your toes and do not flare out or cave inward.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you lift your hips and inhaling as you lower them back down.
Use a pad or towel on the barbell for added comfort on your hips.
results.description: Barbell Kas Glute Bridge is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Lower Back.
